docs.text: ⚗️ Athanor OS Wiki "a distro for the anti normie" ⚠️ Status: Compiling... The Athanor documentation forge is currently being lit. Detailed installation handbooks, system configuration guides, and musl / Clang packaging workarounds are coming soon . We are actively migrating our internal developer notes and architectural guidelines into this public knowledge base. Check back soon for updates. 🌌 About The Project Athanor is a high-performance, Gentoo-based Linux distribution built on the principles of divergence, minimalism, and speed . Mainstream computing has accepted bloat, monolithic dependencies, and hand-holding as the default. We reject that. Athanor is an operating system forged strictly for the enthusiast, the tinkerer, and the power user who demands absolute control over every CPU cycle. If you want an OS that stays out of your way and respects your hardware, you have found it. ⚙️ The Athanor Stack We strip away the cruft and rebuild the Linux experience from the source up: * Gentoo-Based: Unparalleled flexibility via source-based package management. * musl libc: We drop the immense weight of glibc for a strict, highly efficient libc. * Clang/LLVM: Compiled with modern toolchains for heavily optimized binaries. * OpenRC: A pure, dependency-based init system. Absolutely zero systemd . 🔗 Where to Find Us While the documentation is currently compiling, you can interact with the core team, view the code, or track our progress using the links below: GitHub Organization: https://github.com/choccynix Community Discord: https://discord.gg/R4dPR9HtAz Dev Roadmap: https://trello.com/b/PWQFmWXS/anthanor-dev-board “Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.”
